notes: Random 16-pole sweep. Labels derived from both-pole cards and top-32 peak-token counts. No band archive covers this neuron. Sentences authored by Codex; no Bonsai-generated sentences. Exploratory probes, when declared, used different sentences from this pre-registration. The pole is broad (1.7% above 0.1 of max) and 86% gate-closed echo, but not flagged dense or positional. Three top examples repeat the translation token; the proposed label covers that subset only.
